topic: Exterior Light Control System (外灯控制系统) - ICB (Integrated Control Block) Service Interface Specifications
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific service interface call or notification related to exterior lighting control, detailing the input parameters, expected states, and output signals for various light functions.
column_semantics: The table does not have explicit columns; instead, it uses a structured text format where each line describes a function call or notification with its associated parameters and status indicators.

core_entities.name: ICB
core_entities.description: Integrated Control Block, responsible for managing and coordinating various exterior light functions.

core_entities.name: HMI

core_entities.description: Rear Headlight Control Module, manages rear headlight functions.

core_conditions.description: Combined light function priority status, determining which light function has priority.

core_conditions.description: Rear fog light switch status, indicating whether the rear fog light is on or off.

core_conditions.name: DippedBeamLightReqSts

core_faults.name: RearFogLightErrorStatus

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the interface specifications for various services related to exterior lighting control within the vehicle's ICB. It outlines how different modules interact with the ICB to control lights such as dipped beams, rear fog lights, and near lights, including their status, error conditions, and control signals. This information is crucial for testing the correct functionality and communication between the ICB and other modules in response to user inputs and system states.
